Yoon So-ra. Before we get married, do that with me."

"I've never slept with a man before. But if the CEO wants to sleep with me, I can sleep right now..."

“Even when I eat a chocolate bar, I’m the first person to give it to someone else.”

5 years of unrequited love.

I confessed infinitely, and kicked infinitely.

How did you end that one-sided love?

"I'm getting married."

"Then me? Didn't you say you liked me?"

Did he come and do this? Even the rising cigarette smoke couldn't cover Jungwoo's jet-black eyes.

"You made a promise to me."

"A promise? You're not mistaken for someone else."

?"

Jungwoo touched my lips with his thumb and grinned.

"Look closely. It's a video you won't get tired of watching."

He pressed the remote control button.

What was captured on the large monitor was me, wearing a white slip, drunkenly seducing him.

*

Yoon So-ra, a woman who ended a five-year unrequited love and is about to get married. Chae Jung-woo, a dangerous man who belatedly realized his feelings and began a fierce courtship.

A terrible romance between two people who cross comedy and thriller!
